items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: I love all that music. You know I play symphony gigs too but not as much as jazz and pop gigs.

ctx.x: But that’s the audience I’m trying to reach because people are not going out to the symphony to hear the Bach, Beethoven, Mozart, Brahms, Debussy, all that stuff. I love all that music. You know I play symphony gigs too but not as much as jazz and pop gigs. But yeah, so they have to do pop music in order to keep themselves financially sound.
Right. One more question about the early time. I’m wondering, as you learned these songs to play in an R & B band etcetera, was there a moment where you realized oh, this is another 12-bar blues?
